name: Cloud Chamber
tagline: A calm rose lab where chrome letters fall, collide and leave particle tracks
summary: The hero is a working physics chamber: ALBRETSEN in liquid chrome drops onto a measured floor, can be grabbed and thrown, and every hard impact draws bubble-chamber spirals in canvas 2D. Live product events (MCP Emails, Fun Libs, Toolrails) enter as labelled tracks and are written to a detector log. It turns real activity into visible physics, which suits a builder whose work runs quietly in the background and is judged by what it leaves behind.
voice: Scientific calm: plain sentences, numbers set like measurements, nothing raised. "Shipped, measured, stopped. Each taught something the live ones use."
motion: Long, even easing with at most one overshoot; text decodes into place out of a churn of brand glyphs, and sections open along the logo's break line.
sound: Off until asked; then glassy two-partial pings, pitched by impact speed, and a soft low tick when a product event crosses the chamber.
mark: Unbounded's A cut along one slanted line with the upper shard shifted; the break line is reused as the section transition and the specimen's hover state.
